modelConfig.title: Model Connection (Cloud / Local)
modelConfig.modeHint: Switching saves and takes effect immediately; parameter changes need "Save config"
modelConfig.masterKeyWarnDesc: Set the environment variable POLICYBOT_MASTER_KEY (32-byte hex, kept by admins, not stored with the system) in the deployment environment and restart to save/read API keys.
modelConfig.fModelFileExtra: Auto-scans the models/llm/ directory; put GGUF models under models/llm/<name>/
modelConfig.fCtxSizeExtra: 8GB GPU recommended ≤16384; can increase with more VRAM (upper limit validated by the model runtime)
modelConfig.fKvQuantizeExtra: On = saves VRAM (q8_0); can turn off with large VRAM (slight precision loss)
modelConfig.fGpuLayersExtra: -1 = all on GPU / 0 = pure CPU / N = first N layers; Windows must specify explicitly (default 40, verified on 8GB)
modelConfig.fThinkingExtra: Off by default (9B thinking is costly with low benefit; not needed for RAG Q&A); enable if quality is insufficient
modelConfig.fConcurrencyExtra: Local 2 concurrency + 60s queue timeout (default; increase with more VRAM/server capacity)
modelConfig.fBaseUrlRequired: Custom providers must fill in the API base URL
modelConfig.fBaseUrlExtraEnv: Not configured in UI (using env var / key file fallback)
modelConfig.fBaseUrlExtra: Fill the API base URL (e.g. https://api.xxx.com/v1), without /chat/completions
modelConfig.fModelExtra: Clicking "Test connection" auto-loads the model list; you can also refresh manually on the right
modelConfig.fModelPh1: Select or type a model name
modelConfig.fModelPh2: With no model list, type the model name directly (e.g. deepseek-chat)
modelConfig.keyMaskedHint: (masked; plaintext not viewable; keys are stored per-provider, no re-entry needed when switching back)
modelConfig.keyMissing: {{provider}} has no key configured — fill it in (keys are stored per-provider, no re-entry needed when switching back)
modelConfig.localNote: Local mode: system-managed llama-server (llama.cpp) loads the selected GGUF; shared by efficient/smart modes; can switch back to cloud API anytime.
modelConfig.cloudNote: Notes: falls back to env vars (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY / DEEPSEEK_MODEL) then the legacy key file when unconfigured; efficient mode (direct API) and smart mode (Pi SDK) share this config; takes effect immediately after saving.
modelConfig.needKey: Please fill in the API Key first (or the provider has a saved key) before refreshing the model list
modelConfig.needKeyProvider: Switched to a provider without a key — fill in that provider's key first, then refresh
modelConfig.keyWarning: Please fill in the API Key first
modelConfig.keyWarningProvider: Switched to a provider without a key — fill in that provider's key first, then test
modelConfig.switchedLocal: Switched to local model; Q&A will use the local engine
modelConfig.switchedCloud: Switched to cloud API; Q&A will use the cloud model

fieldDicts.fInContextExtra: Used only for "am I eligible / does it apply to me" judgments; not proactively shown; do not enable for sensitive fields
fieldDicts.csvIntro:

security.subtitle: Security levels (tiers + behavior policy), read protection (watermark / copy protection), audit log
security.levelsHint: Levels are maintained on this page (not in user attributes, to avoid confusion with user fields); the "level key" cannot be modified after creation (stable stored value), the "name" can be changed (for display). Disabled levels are not removed (existing policy tiers are kept); levels referenced by policies cannot be deleted.
security.deleteLevelInUse: This level is still referenced by policies and cannot be deleted — disable it or migrate policy security levels first.
security.deleteLevelConfirm: The level's policy will be cleared upon deletion.

behaviorHint.watermark: Add watermark to read page (user name + employee no. + time)
behaviorHint.ai_searchable: Can be cited by Q&A; off = humans can read but AI never cites

security.aiSearchableDesc: When off, policies at this level do not enter AI Q&A retrieval candidates for anyone (including admins) — humans can read normally, but AI will not cite them (preventing confidential content from being leaked via bulk citation). This is an independent gate from visibility (who can see as a human).
security.auditReadNote: "Browse audit" = whether normal reads are recorded; unauthorized access attempts (403) are always recorded (no switch — someone trying to access an unauthorized policy is a security event, independent of the target level).
security.keyLabel: Level key (English/no., cannot be modified after creation)
security.nameLabel: Name (for display, can be changed later)
security.nameEnLabel: English name (for display, can be changed later)
security.readProtectTitle: ② Read protection (global; level policy takes precedence)
security.watermarkGlobal: Read page watermark (user name + employee no. + time, traceable screenshots)
security.copyProtectGlobal: Read page copy protection (Ctrl+C / right-click / drag-select)
security.readProtectNote: Policies matching a security level use the level policy; policies without a security level use the global switches.
security.forceChangeGlobal: Force password change on first login (new users & after password reset)
security.forceChangeNote: When enabled, new users and users whose password was reset must change it on first login; initial password is Pass1234, communicated by the administrator when creating the account.
security.auditDir: Log directory (server-local, JSON Lines split by day):
security.auditNote: Audit content includes: admin operations, login/logout, level-browsing (read_policy), unauthorized attempts (read_policy_denied), etc. Server files only; viewable only with system configuration permission.

groups.builtinHint: Built-in roles: System administrator = all functions and all scope (manual membership only); Employee = query + retrieval (default for all). Functions/scope/rules are not configurable.
groups.managedScope: Managed scope (which libraries it can manage)
groups.managedScopePlaceholder: Select libraries (choosing "All" grants management of newly created libraries; none selected = manages no library)
groups.managedScopeHint: Managed scope applies only to "Policy library content operations" (per-library authorization); policy library global management applies globally without authorization.
groups.fnOrthogonalHint: The two policy-library permissions are orthogonal: global management = manage library structure (create/delete/attributes, cannot edit files inside); content operations = manage files in authorized libraries (upload/publish/retire, cannot create/delete libraries).
groups.sysAdminHint: Functions: Policy management / User management / Role management / System configuration; Managed scope: all libraries (new libraries automatically included)
groups.employeeHint: Functions: Read policy source + smart retrieval (fixed); Managed scope: none
groups.excludeMembers: Excluded members (excluded even if rules match)
groups.includeMembers: Included members (added directly regardless of rules)
groups.memberSearch: Search name / employee no. to add {{label}}
groups.previewMembers: View member list under latest rules (preview based on current edits)
groups.toggleContent: Members of this role will no longer get permissions after disabling (configuration is kept, recoverable)
groups.deleteConfirmContent: The group, its rules, and members will be permanently deleted, and its management references in libraries removed. This cannot be undone. Confirm?
groups.fnLibGlobal: Policy library global management (create/delete/disable/edit attributes, global scope)
groups.fnLibContent: Policy library content operations (maintain files in authorized libraries, per-library authorization)
